transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time for this pre-purchase review. As you know, we're considering the vendor's indoor-air-quality monitoring system for the science wing. The discussion so far has focused on the six-monitor package at $3,100, though there is also a nine-monitor package available at $4,320. Before I record my approval, I'd like to hear from each of you on any findings relevant to this purchase. Let's start with the facilities manager — do you have anything to report regarding the science wing's air quality or infrastructure as it relates to this system?

transcript.text: I need to report an important finding from my inspection this week. I found that the science wing actually has nine classrooms, each with separate ventilation zones, meaning each room needs its own monitor. The six-monitor package would leave three classrooms unmonitored. I completed this room-by-room inspection this week, but the report hasn't been entered into the purchasing worksheet yet, which is likely why the discussion has focused on the six-monitor package.
